body.purpose: Readable case-study narrative capped near 70 characters.

label.purpose: Evidence metadata, state, and system orientation.

shadows.name: ambient-stage
shadows.purpose: Only for a major moving stage separating from the background.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Press, focus, and small state feedback.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Warm paper-like action used once in the hero.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display:inline-flex; background:#F2EFE8; color:#070A0B; padding:14px 20px; border-radius:3px; font:600 15px/1 Instrument Sans,Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-action-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6FE0CF; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Workflow Atlas
components.description: The light schematic surface that pairs an authoritative system map with its decision and correction tree.
components.html: System flow · Decision + correction
components.css: .ds-workflow-atlas { background:#F4F1E9; color:#17212D; border:1px solid #D7D4CA; } .ds-workflow-atlas nav { background:#17212D; color:#F2EFE8; padding:12px 20px; } .ds-workflow-atlas figure { min-height:480px; margin:0; padding:24px; overflow:hidden; }

narrative.overview: A quiet, dimly lit operations room where inspectable work moves through framed evidence, routing rails, human review, and controlled release.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Teal, amber, and red communicate system state and are forbidden as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Large sans language carries meaning; mono language orients the reader inside the system.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Evidence surfaces remain stable and use elevation only to express hierarchy.

dos: Do make the first viewport complete before animation runs.
Do connect every state to real case evidence.
Do preserve keyboard, touch, mobile, and reduced-motion access.
donts: Don't use neon-grid AI startup styling.
Don't fabricate metrics, testimonials, or system telemetry.
Don't hijack scrolling or animate layout properties.
